{{PAGENAME}}, as well as the other variants ([[Dark heart]], [[Dark intestine]]), will randomly appear on newly delivered corpses. Obtained after progressing far enough through the [[Inquisitor]] quest-line.

==Quest==
The [[Inquisitor]] needs evidence for the presence of a cult in the [[town]] to convince the king of the inquisition's plans. For this he asks you to bring him one {{PAGENAME}}, one [[Dark heart]] and one [[Dark intestine]].
